{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = df_clean[(df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df_clean['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check the filtered population
print(f"Number of LOYAL completed orders after removing QA: {len(loyal_completed)}")

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Output result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from LOYAL customers (after removing QA): {mean_revenue}")"}
